secondaryIdInfos.domain: National Cancer Institute of Canada Clinical Trials Group

identificationModule.briefTitle: Gefitinib in Treating Patients With Stage IB, II, or IIIA Non-small Cell Lung Cancer That Was Completely Removed by Surgery
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Prospective Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial of the Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor Antagonist, ZD1839 (IRESSA) in Completely Resected Primary Stage IB, II and IIIA Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

armGroups.label: Arm I (gefitinib)
armGroups.description: Patients receive gefitinib PO QD for 2 years in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

armGroups.label: Arm II (placebo)
armGroups.description: Patients receive placebo PO QD for 2 years in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
